text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was training time. I decided to measure 
Daitaku Helios's top speed.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes♪ Trainie's always tellin' me that 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's rip it up!! Time to go all 
ou—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Wheeeewww!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...A gale is coming... No, this is 
something far more fierce and roaring—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha! The absolute beeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A storm...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whew~! We did iiit!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A wind that sweeps up everything in its 
path. I couldn't help but be captivated by 
it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Zeph-chi, you were watching!? So hyped!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A vortex had formed, with Ms. Helios at 
its center.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"And that sharpness like a slashing 
blade... Just how did she cultivate such a 
wind?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Ah! Use your whole body and go 
KA-POW! Or something! That's what Trainie 
said!
choice_data_list: Imagine engaging every muscle in your body

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trai-pi! Totally!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Also, hardcore stretching every single 
day! Trainy thought up a whole bunch of 
other stuff too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It seems you have caught a favorable 
tailwind. Allow me to whip up the breeze 
even further...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Zephyr-chi praised me!? No way!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Knew my Trainie was the abso-freakin'-lute 
best~! Your coaching is out of this world!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I can get way more hyped than this! Keep 
'em coming, let's goooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios is steadily building up her 
strength. Looks like the training is 
paying off!
